# Security & Pipeline Requirements Quality Checklist: DevSecOps for MisiOps

**Purpose**: Unit-test the requirements (spec, plan, contracts) for secrets handling, gate semantics, report retention, DefectDojo import correctness, supply-chain pinning and evidence completeness for items 2a-2k
**Created**: 2026-11-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Secrets Handling

- [ ] CHK001 Are all credentials the pipeline consumes enumerated (DefectDojo URL/token, registry token, DAST test-user credentials), each with its source in the CI secret store? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the origin of the bearer token used by the authenticated API scan specified, and is it stated that it is created at run time rather than stored in the repository? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK003 Is it specified that the DefectDojo token and tunnel address must never appear in logs, step summaries or artifacts? [Clarity, Contracts upload-script]
- [ ] CHK004 Is "including history" in FR-006 defined with a scope (full history of all branches vs. the PR's commits)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the criteria that distinguish an allow-listable test value (CI-only `SECRET_KEY`, dummy compose values) from a real secret documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012b]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the required response defined when a real secret is found in history (rotation, not only allow-listing)? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the accepted risk of DefectDojo default credentials exposed through a public tunnel bounded (tunnel only up during sessions, test data only, owner of the risk)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 Does the spec state how the pre-commit secret check is distributed to the team and what happens when a developer has not installed it? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, §SC-006]

## Gate Semantics

- [ ] CHK009 Is "fail on any CRITICAL or HIGH finding" consistent with the per-job gates in the contract (Semgrep ERROR severity, Trivy image "with a fix available", ZAP FAIL rules)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012, Contracts pipeline-jobs]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the mapping from each tool's native severity scale to CRITICAL/HIGH documented for Semgrep, Gitleaks, TruffleHog and ZAP? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the treatment of HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerabilities with no available fix specified (gate, suppression with justification, or accepted risk)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-012b]
- [ ] CHK012 Is it specified that each scanner's report is produced and kept even when its gate fails? [Completeness, Contracts pipeline-jobs rule 1]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the gate outcome specified when a scanner itself errors (vulnerability DB download failure, ZAP cannot reach the stack) rather than finding issues? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK014 Is it unambiguous whether a DefectDojo upload failure may turn the run red, given FR-011 says uploads must never fail any scan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Contracts pipeline-jobs `defectdojo`]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the conditions under which the delivery stage runs (event, branch, required jobs) fully listed, including `scripts-test`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015a]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the suppression review date semantics defined (what happens when a date passes)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012b]
- [ ] CHK017 Does FR-012a name the exact checks that become required and the role able to change the setting? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012a]

## Report Retention & Traceability

- [ ] CHK018 Is the 7-day retention reconciled with the time needed to write and grade the evidence document, and is a durable copy of baseline/re-scan reports required? [Gap, Spec §NFR-003, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK019 Is it specified which reports form the "baseline" and the "re-scan" (run IDs, commits) so the before/after comparison is reproducible? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Are report formats required per tool defined so every report is importable (e.g., ZAP XML, TruffleHog NDJSON filtering)? [Completeness, Data model §Scan Report]
- [ ] CHK021 Is persistence of DefectDojo data across local restarts required, since the before/after evidence lives there? [Gap, Assumption]

## DefectDojo Import Correctness

- [ ] CHK022 Is the uniqueness rule for test titles stated as a requirement, not only as a research decision? [Traceability, Spec §FR-010a, Research R7]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the engagement naming rule (per branch) defined for PR runs, push runs and the local fallback so they do not collide or close each other's findings? [Consistency, Data model §DefectDojo hierarchy]
- [ ] CHK024 Is "closed" in FR-010a defined against the finding lifecycle states (Mitigated vs. False Positive vs. Risk Accepted)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010a]
- [ ] CHK025 Is it required that repository suppressions are mirrored as Risk Accepted in DefectDojo, and who performs that step? [Gap, Data model §Finding lifecycle]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the fallback import required to produce the same product/engagement/test structure as the CI upload? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011a]
- [ ] CHK027 Is behaviour defined for an empty report (zero findings) so a clean re-scan still closes previous findings instead of being skipped? [Edge Case, Conflict, Contracts upload-script "report empty → skip", Spec §FR-010a]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the expected scan type for every report listed so a wrong parser cannot silently import zero findings? [Completeness, Contracts upload-script]

## Supply-Chain Pinning

- [ ] CHK029 Does "pinned to a specific version" (NFR-002) state whether tags are sufficient or digests/commit SHAs are required for images and actions? [Ambiguity, Spec §NFR-002]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the pinning requirement extended to CI actions, base images (`uv:latest`) and the DefectDojo deployment, or are they explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Spec §NFR-002, Research R6]
- [ ] CHK031 Is it specified that delivered images are the exact bytes that were scanned? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015a, Plan §Complexity Tracking]
- [ ] CHK032 Are least-privilege permissions for the workflow (default read, write only where publishing) stated as a requirement? [Gap, Contracts pipeline-jobs]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the behaviour for pull requests from forks (no secrets available) specified for upload and delivery? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011]

## Evidence Completeness (Items 2a-2k)

- [ ] CHK034 Does each item 2a-2k map to at least one requirement, so no course item lacks an owning FR? [Traceability, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK035 Is "screenshot impossible" defined, so the use of logs instead of screenshots is objectively justified? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the before/after metric for item 2h defined (open findings by severity, source view in DefectDojo)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK037 Are the minimum contents of the pipeline diagram (stages, gates, artifacts, delivery) specified for item 2i? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK038 Is "concisely" for items 2j/2k quantified (e.g., length per sub-question)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK039 Can SC-005 ("locate any item in under one minute") be verified objectively (index, anchors per item)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the dependency on manual steps (STRIDE templates, shared links, owner-set secrets) reflected in the acceptance criteria, with what the evidence shows if a step is not done? [Dependency, Plan §Manual steps]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK009, CHK014 and CHK027 flag likely conflicts between spec and contracts; resolve before `/speckit-tasks` or let `/speckit-analyze` track them
